site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and generative-AI development provider, an offer that conflicts with the current staffing and recruiting position. Rebuild it around the approved description and current services, and remove or verify the unsupported promises and claims listed below.

llm_problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity
llm_problems.issue: The schema describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and a broad talent acquisition agency rather than using the approved staffing and recruiting description specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the old positioning with the approved company description and current service positioning.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby description
llm_problems.page_value: Applied AI Engineering partner; talent acquisition agency
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner
locations.reason: This label positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner rather than the approved staffing and recruiting agency.

locations.quote: We are a US-based talent acquisition agency specializing in assisting tech companies
locations.reason: This describes a broad talent acquisition agency rather than an agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.

locations.quote: GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner turning engineering into AI-native production
locations.reason: This repeats the old Applied AI Engineering partner positioning instead of the approved company description.

llm_problems.title: Obsolete development services
llm_problems.issue: The schema sells Applied AI Engineering and generative-AI development work, while GoGloby is not a software development shop and does not offer these services.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the development-service catalog and retain only descriptions of the current recruiting and nearshore staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: Generative AI development services
llm_problems.page_value: Applied AI Engineering and generative AI development
llm_problems.source_value: Recruiting and staffing engineers; clients run the work

locations.quote: GoGloby Applied AI Engineering Service Catalog
locations.reason: This presents an Applied AI Engineering service catalog that is not among GoGloby's current services.

locations.quote: Generative AI Development Services
locations.reason: This names a software development service GoGloby does not offer.

locations.quote: GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications
locations.reason: This promises that GoGloby engineers build AI software for clients, contrary to the company's staffing and recruiting model.

locations.quote: Forward-deployed AI Solutions Architects, safe by design.
locations.reason: This presents AI Solutions Architects as a service offer rather than as a role GoGloby recruits or staffs.

llm_problems.issue: The stated responsibility for secure development environment design is not in the company sources.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify this responsibility before retaining it in the structured data.

locations.quote: secure development environment design
locations.reason: This assigns Sergey responsibility for designing a secure development environment, which the founder profile does not state.
